description:
Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-65400: Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.. Product: macOS

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_general_009", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%cve%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%2026%') AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%CVE-%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%exploit%') AND "value" > 0
